verdict.rationale: Cake has permissioned sharing through the My Cake portal: investors and employees see only their own holdings, admins control exactly what they can see, and linked share certificates are available to shareholders. That is individual stakeholder access, not a diligence data room combining cap table views with underlying documents for counsel. Missing for 10: a dedicated data room feature, document repository and sharing beyond certificates, counsel or advisor access roles, granular folder- or document-level permissions, access logs, and independent corroboration.
